description: What the main window's page is allowed to ask of the backend. Deliberately short: the page opens links and the logs folder, and everything else it needs goes through this app's own commands. `fs:default` is gone because it granted recursive read of the whole app-data folder -- user.db, the backups, the logs -- to any script running in the webview, and nothing in the page uses the fs plugin. `dialog:default` is gone because the file dialogs now run in Rust (see commands::file_picker), so the page has no reason to open one.
